515:t_009:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「I won't lose! I refuse to lose!!」

515:t_010:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Stop, $$リディ$$! Using your power that way will only destroy you!」

515:t_011:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「This naked rage...! It's dangerous!」

515:t_011:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$バナージ$$! Now the conditions are even!」

515:t_011:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「With this thing's power, I'll defeat you!!」

515:t_012:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「Let's go, $c! I'll show you this thing's... no, my power!」

515:t_013:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「So some $$ザフト$$ forces were still left!」

515:t_014:1.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Have they come to protect the $$コーディネイター$$s?」

515:t_015:1.en:
$$ノイン$$
「Is $$アプリリウス市$$ their target too!?」

515:t_015:2.en:
$$カトル$$
「Attacking Ensign $$リディ$$, a Conservative, I can understand, but why the $$プラント$$...!?」

515:t_015:3.en:
$$デュオ$$
「They must be acting on some screwy logic, same as their captain!」

515:t_015:4.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「And it seems they've made us a higher-priority target than Ensign $$リディ$$.」

515:t_015:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, intercept Ensign $$リディ$$ while you defend the $$プラント$$ from the Reformists!」

515:t_015:6.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Easier said than done, this is a tough situation!」

515:t_015:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
「At this rate we don't have enough firepower...!」

515:t_016:3.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「$$シン$$... with that wound, fighting is...」

515:t_016:5.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'll go out front. $$シン$$, cover me.」

515:t_016:7.en:
$$キラ$$
「Rely on me once in a while. I'm your friend too, after all.」

515:t_016:9.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$キラ$$ and $$シン$$, defend $$アプリリウス市$$! All units, focus your attacks on Ensign $$リディ$$!」

515:t_016:10.en:
$$リディ$$
「With this power, even I can do it!」

515:t_016:11.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「$$バンシィ$$... So you've finally unleashed that power.」

515:t_016:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But I have to do it...! If we let Ensign $$リディ$$ keep fighting any longer, there'll be no taking it back!」

515:t_017:1.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「It's impossible after all, $$シン$$!」

515:t_017:2.en:
$$シン$$
「No, $$ルナ$$! I'm a member of $$ザフト$$ too!」

515:t_017:4.en:
$$シン$$
「$$レイ#pt136$$ tried to carry on the Chairman's plan, I lost my own way of thinking... it all began with war...!」

515:t_017:5.en:
$$シン$$
「If the $$プラント$$ are burned here and now, more kids like me and $$レイ#pt136$$ will be born!」

515:t_018:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It's been a while, $n, $$セツコ$$. And everyone in $c, too.」

515:t_018:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「What are you attacking the $$プラント$$ for!?」

515:t_018:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「Aren't the $$コーディネイター$$s something you Reformists created!?」

515:t_018:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「For the descendants of the Reformists to cozy up to the $$サイデリアル$$ is something that must never be.」

515:t_018:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Having lost their purpose, they are no longer comrades. Then purging them is my duty.」

515:t_018:9.en:
$$シン$$
「What kind of selfish logic is that!」

515:t_018:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You first, bearers of the factor.」

515:t_019:0.en:
$$クロノ隊員$$
「A pity. Now that you've lost your purpose, the $$コーディネイター$$s are nothing but meaningless beings.」

515:t_019:1.en:
$$クロノ隊員$$
「You are a hollow species, born seeking only ability. In other words, monsters of space.」

515:t_019:3.en:
$$シン$$
「The $$コーディネイター$$s... we are...!」

515:t_020:0.en:
$$アスラン$$
「Neither $$キラ$$ nor $$シン$$ is a monster.」

515:t_020:4.en:
$$アーサー$$
「Sorry, $$シン$$. I let the Defense Committee Chairman get away because of my mistake.」

515:t_020:5.en:
$$シン$$
「Understood! Thank you, XO $$アーサー$$!」

515:t_021:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「Let's do it, $$アスラン$$! With your power and mine!」

515:t_022:0.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Amazing! It's been so long, yet their teamwork is perfectly in sync!」

515:t_023:0.en:
$$シン$$
「Let's go, $$レイ#pt136$$! I'll make your feelings and mine one!」

515:t_024:0.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「It's been a while since I felt this rhythm...」

515:t_024:2.en:
$$シン$$
「Of course it does! We combined our strengths!」

515:t_024:4.en:
$$シン$$
「Let's do it, $$レイ#pt136$$. We'll protect the $$プラント$$ together.」
